title: Round624: batched Rust rollout speed and player-view invariance
status: CPU batch probe and sampled closed-sheet check passed; not integrated into PPO
format: Local Champions Reg M-C doubles with open-team-sheet rule removed

throughput.policy: Uniform random legal choice index from each batched action row
throughput.request_refusals: 2 to 8 per trial; the batch exposes the refreshed request and the loop continues
throughput.timed_work: Ninjask Batch observe/step loop plus Python random legal-choice selection
throughput.scope_limit: This is not end-to-end training throughput, not an evaluation-strength result, and not a GPU simulator benchmark.

batch_player_view_audit.team_preview_choice: Action row 0 selects positions 1-4 for both paired games; positions 5-6 remain unselected.
batch_player_view_audit.scope_limit: Sampled trajectories with selected rosters fixed. P2's own observation may differ because it legitimately knows its own changed sets. This does not cover every mechanic or active hidden-set case.

methodology_correction: An initial probe randomized team preview and therefore sometimes selected one of the mutated members; those observation differences were legitimate. The audit now fixes the same first-four roster in both worlds before checking privacy.
next: Connect Batch numeric player-view observations and legal-action rows to a batched version of the current policy, then measure CPU/GPU inference and end-to-end self-play throughput before starting a large PPO run.
